summary: C1 Explore review requests changes. Revision 042 resolves the ResultRef self-reference, but the completion protocol still has a time-of-check/time-of-use race: multiple writers can each observe a pending Run, pass assertMutable, and then use the overwrite-capable atomicWriteFile to publish different result.json contents. That permits replacement of a terminal result.

blockingFindings.title: Terminal result publication has no exclusive single-writer claim
blockingFindings.evidence: Q5 stage 2 performs read current pending state, assertMutable, then atomicWriteFile(result.json). Two writers can both finish the read/check before either publish. A1 atomicWriteFile writes a temporary file and renames it onto the target, so it provides atomic replacement of one file but no no-replace compare-and-swap guarantee. The later writer can replace the first terminal result.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Define an exclusive, no-replace completion-publication protocol: a writer must atomically claim completion before a terminal result can be published, losing writers must receive RUN_TERMINAL or an equivalent conflict, and recovery of an interrupted claim must be fail-closed. Do not rely on a preliminary exists check. Add a deterministic concurrent-writer fixture proving the first result remains unchanged and the loser cannot overwrite it.

resolvedFindings.resolution: Resolved by revision 042: physical serialization omits ActionResult.runRef and derives it from the finalized file content on read.

checks.name: Formal concurrency and immutability review
checks.result: Reviewed C1 completion ordering against B1 terminal immutability and A1 atomicWriteFile behavior.
